## Calculate the BaseEF and EF

```{r EF caluclation}

USData <- read_rds("../Input/US_Direct_Crop_2018-2022_GrainAgg.rds") # silage included data


#Calculate the EF
Result <- N2OEF_direct(USData) 


summary(Result$Result_Prov_Crop$N2O.IEF)
#mean IEF = 0.006062, median IEF = 0.005499
#write.csv(Result$Result_Prov_Crop,"../Output/Direct N2O_CRN_US_GrainAgg.csv",row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r Grain Split}
USData <- read_rds("../Input/US_Direct_Crop_2018-2022_GrainSplit.rds") # silage included data


#Calculate the EF
Result <- N2OEF_direct(USData) 


summary(Result$Result_Prov_Crop$N2O.IEF)
#mean IEF = 0.006217, median IEF = 0.005607
```
